source_text.body:
Manage a vacant rental through to a signed lease
A commenter says Meta's Muse managed a vacant rental end to end and booked a 2-year lease worth over $75,000 in rent.
·
Nov 16, 2026
Done with
MM
Meta Muse
What they did
The commenter says Muse handled a vacant rental “from start to finish,” ending with a signed 2-year lease. In follow-up comments, they only add that the property was a gated 3-bedroom with a pool in Las Vegas; they do not describe the specific steps, tools, or where they personally intervened.
How it went
They report that it booked a 2-year lease worth over $75,000 in rent. The thread gives no further detail on leasing workflow, screening, or any problems along the way.
Worth knowing
The useful concrete detail is the economics: the lease was for over $75,000 total rent on a Las Vegas gated 3-bedroom with a pool.
Try it yourself
with
Meta Muse
Copy prompt
Help me manage my vacant rental at [address] from listing to signed lease. Write and post the listing with [rent, lease length, features], answer inquiries from prospective tenants, schedule showings on [my available times], and keep a tracker of each lead's status. Before you send any message, share an application or lease, or commit to a showing or terms, show me the draft and wait for my approval. Finish when I have a signed lease or a shortlist of qualified applicants.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/MuseAgent/comments/1xwpgtp/what_is_the_coolest_thing_you_have_actually_done
